canada.title: Man wanted for second-degree murder arrested in Regina: RCMP

canada.title: N.L. man could be barred from entering U.S. due to Trump Facebook comment
canada.summary: A man in St. John’s, N.L., could be barred from ever travelling south of the border after the U.S. Secret Service flagged a Facebook comment he doesn’t even remember making against President Donald Trump.

canada.title: Burnaby RCMP officer prevents accident after inspecting commercial truck

canada.title: Calgary's 4-year budget proposes 15% property tax hike, rising water rates
canada.summary: City administration released the 2027-2030 budget to the public on Tuesday, and it proposes a double-digit property tax increase to catch up with a growing population and aging infrastructure.

canada.title: New Brunswick’s first data-centre town has thoughts to share
canada.summary: Long before data centre proposals in Lorneville and Miramichi were stirring opposition, and long before the province was grappling with how to regulate the sector, Gus Rioux was marching off to the Grand Falls town office, petition in hand.

canada.title: Montreal man handed life sentence, no parole for 22 years for 2024 murder of pregnant wife

canada.title: Joanne Thompson says homelessness can end in 10 years — but it requires collaboration
canada.summary: Two days after the 2026 federal budget was tabled, St. John’s East MP and Fisheries Minister Joanne Thompson visited her home riding to promote the ambitious plan to end homelessness across Canada within a decade.

canada.title: Man who pleaded guilty to firing at Jewish school in Montreal given 5.5-year sentence
canada.summary: A man who pleaded guilty to firing shots at a Jewish school in Montreal three years ago has been sentenced to five-and-a-half years in prison. According to the Crown Prosecutor's Office, with time served, Abdirazak Mahdi Ahmed has about 18 months left on his sentence.

canada.title: Port Hawkesbury Mayor Brenda Chisholm-Beaton on how her Cape Breton town has evolved, and what’s next
canada.summary: Chisholm-Beaton is the first woman mayor of Port Hawkesbury, and the first woman mayor on Cape Breton Island.

canada.title: Ontario appoints 8 new regional chairs after controversial rule change lets minister hand-pick appointees
canada.summary: Ontario's municipal affairs minister has appointed eight regional heads of council, following a controversial legislative change that let the Ford government hand-pick appointees who otherwise would have been elected to their position.

canada.title: Lawyer awaiting evidence in alleged Elsipogtog murder
canada.summary: The lawyer for a man accused of killing a 21-year-old Elsipogtog First Nation man says he's still awaiting disclosure of the Crown's evidence in the case.

canada.title: What's open and closed on Remembrance Day in Winnipeg
canada.summary: Some businesses, services and organizations will be closed or operating at reduced hours for Remembrance Day on Wednesday. Here's a look at what's open and closed in Winnipeg.

canada.title: Halifax man charged for allegedly spiking woman's drink at downtown bar
canada.summary: Police arrived at Durty Nelly's Irish Pub on Argyle Street early Saturday morning and found an unresponsive woman who had become ill after consuming a drink that a man was seen giving her.

canada.title: Man arrested after $1K stolen from poppy box: Brandon police
canada.summary: A man was arrested Saturday morning for allegedly stealing roughly $1,000 in cash from a poppy donation box, police in Brandon., Man., say.

canada.title: ‘Things will never be the same’: Wainwright prepares for Remembrance Day after fire
canada.summary: The Alberta town of Wainwright is gearing up for what could be the most solemn Remembrance Day in its recent history, says Mayor Bruce Pugh.
